messages.author: ab7b24da45678eac
messages.subject: g++ segfault with -O2 -DNDEBUG on Mac
parts:
It is not a big deal, but it might be good to know that g++ 4.2.1 in Xcode 4.5.2 on Mountain Lion will fail to compile the following file under flag -O2 and -DNDEBUG.  I came across this when I failed to build rstan because I forgot to call set_cppo() again after I used set_cppo('presentation2'), in which -O2 and -DNDEBUG are used.  

In general, I looked at compiling file in Stan directly under these flags. 

mmac2:stan jq$ g++ -I src -I lib/eigen_3.1.1 -I lib/boost_1.51.0 -O2 -Wall -Wno-unused-function   -c -o bin/stan/agrad/matrix.o src/stan/agrad/matrix.cpp 

mmac2:stan jq$ g++ -DNDEBUG -I src -I lib/eigen_3.1.1 -I lib/boost_1.51.0 -O2 -Wall -Wno-unused-function   -c -o bin/stan/agrad/matrix.o src/stan/agrad/matrix.cpp 
src/stan/agrad/matrix.cpp:136: internal compiler error: Segmentation fault: 11
Please submit a full bug report,
with preprocessed source if appropriate.
See <URL:http://developer.apple.com/bugreporter> for instructions.

mmac2:stan jq$ g++ -DNDEBUG -I src -I lib/eigen_3.1.1 -I lib/boost_1.51.0 -O3 -Wall -Wno-unused-function   -c -o bin/stan/agrad/matrix.o src/stan/agrad/matrix.cpp 

mmac2:stan jq$ 
mmac2:stan jq$ g++ -v
Using built-in specs.

messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] g++ segfault with -O2 -DNDEBUG on Mac
parts:
On 11/2/12 5:25 PM, Jiqiang Guo wrote:
> It is not a big deal,

I get the same problem on my machine (g++ segfaulting)
with the same config (Xcode 4.5.2 + OS X Mountain Lion).
Here's a fuller report:

options | result
--------------------------
-O0 | OK
-O0 -DNEBUG | OK
--------------------------
-O2 | OK
-O2 -DNEBUG | fail
--------------------------
-O3 | OK
-O3 -DNEBUG | OK


Oddly, it's only -O2 -DNDEBUG failing.

So I guess we can work around this, but it's annoying.

Is -O2 -DNEBUG the default for R before fiddling?
If so, it's probably going to frustrate a lot of users.

> but it might be good to know that g++ 4.2.1 in Xcode 4.5.2 on Mountain Lion will fail to compile
> the following file under flag -O2 and -DNDEBUG. I came across this when I failed to build rstan because I forgot to
> call set_cppo() again after I used set_cppo('presentation2'), in which -O2 and -DNDEBUG are used.

The failure is in agrad/matrix.hpp, which is the most
problematic of all of our files because it involves
auto-dif templating on top of Eigen's templating.

- Bob

messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] g++ segfault with -O2 -DNDEBUG on Mac

On Fri, Nov 2, 2012 at 10:05 PM, Ben Goodrich <goodri...@gmail.com> wrote:
On Friday, November 2, 2012 8:12:00 PM UTC-4, Jiqiang Guo wrote:
In general there is no problem for rstan since in O3 is used by default.  The only case is that if O2 is set by the user in $HOME/.R/Makevars.  (I guess this problem has been there for long, but we don't know.)

Or if the user doesn't ever call set_cppo().

package rstan uses a Makeefile in which the setting of O3 will overrule R's default O2. 
So there is not a problem if users do not call set_cppo() at all.  Once rstan is installed, 
this file need not be compiled.
